# Chifbay

> Private boat trips in Madeira, from Marina do Funchal, Portugal. One boat, one group at a time, never a shared tour. A flat price for the whole boat, up to 5 guests, two licensed local skippers, direct online booking with live availability.

Last updated: 2026-10-18

Chifbay is a licensed maritime tourism operator in Funchal, Madeira (RNAAT 305/2026, company CHIF&CO, Lda, NIPC 518603750). Vessel registration (Matrícula) 144363-3PT, insurance policy (Nº de Apólice) BR66385591.

Chifbay runs a single private boat, a 2026 Karnic R8S (9 metres, Mercury V8 300 hp, swim platform, bathroom on board), crewed by two Chifbay skippers on every trip. Guests from different bookings are never mixed.

## The trips

Both trips leave from Marina do Funchal, Pontoon C. Prices are for the whole boat, not per person.

- **Day trip with a swim**: leaves at 10:00 or 14:00. 2 h 30 for 500 EUR (turns at Ribeira Brava) or 3 h for 600 EUR (on to Ponta do Sol). Câmara de Lobos, Cabo Girão (a sea cliff of about 580 m), a swim and paddle boards at Fajã dos Padres, a cove no road reaches.
- **Sunset trip**: leaves 1 h 15 before sunset, all year, so the time moves with the season (about 16:45 in December, about 20:00 in June). 2 h for 400 EUR (turns at Cabo Girão) or 2 h 30 for 500 EUR (on to Ribeira Brava). No swim stop. Complimentary Portuguese wine.
- **Every trip includes**: food and drinks on board (local wine, poncha, beer, soft drinks, snacks), an Insta360 360° video, drone footage from above (weather allowing) and photos taken with a real camera.
- **Cancellation**: free up to 24 hours before departure.
- **Special night**: New Year's Eve fireworks from the water, 31 December 2026, 22:00 to 01:00, 3,000 EUR for the whole boat, everything included.

## Quick answers about boat trips in Madeira

- **How much does a boat trip in Madeira cost?** On GetYourGuide (our count of 58 listings, 11 August 2026), shared trips had a median of 59 EUR per person and private boats a median of 537 EUR for the whole boat. Chifbay costs 400 to 600 EUR for the whole boat, up to 5 guests (80 EUR each for five on the 2 h sunset trip).
- **Where do boat trips leave from?** Most leave from Marina do Funchal, in the city centre. A few operators work from Calheta, on the west of the south coast.
- **What kinds of boat trips are there?** Shared catamarans, whale and dolphin watching, sailing, and private boats. A full comparison with nine named operators: https://chifbay.com/best-boat-trips-madeira
- **Which boat trip goes to Cabo Girão and Fajã dos Padres?** Every Chifbay trip goes to Cabo Girão; the day trip also stops to swim at Fajã dos Padres.
- **Are dolphins guaranteed?** No trip can promise wild animals. On Chifbay's coastal trips dolphins are a bonus, never a promise. For whales and dolphins, a specialist whale watching operator is the better pick.
- **Is it good for cruise passengers?** Marina do Funchal is on the same seafront as the cruise port, so a 2 or 3 hour trip fits most port days. Choose a trip that ends well before all aboard.
- **How many people fit?** Up to 5 guests. For 6 to 12 people, a larger private boat from another operator suits better.
